classification.difficultyReason: Apply the equal opposite sides property directly to two given side lengths.

content.prompt: In the diagram to the right, $XYZW$ is a parallelogram. What are the lengths of $WZ$ and $YZ$? Give reasons for your answer.

spec.description: Unshaded parallelogram XYZW, with X bottom left, Y top left, Z top right and W bottom right. Single parallel marks identify XY and WZ; double parallel marks identify YZ and XW.
spec.mathematics: XY = 5 cm and XW = 4 cm; XY is parallel to WZ and YZ is parallel to XW.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and parallel marks are visible; requested lengths are not supplied.

answer.short: $WZ=5\text{ cm}$ and $YZ=4\text{ cm}$, because opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal.
answer.worked:
Opposite sides of parallelogram $XYZW$ are equal.
$$\begin{align*}WZ&=XY=5\text{ cm},\\YZ&=XW=4\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
